findings.confidence: SOURCE confirmed; restart acceptance still needed
findings.title: Unbound task AI conversation has no visible resume after completed turn/process restart
findings.problem: Only explicit resumeId or pending turn journal restores intake ID. Successful turn clears journal; Home draft links are existing NEED records, not all unbound conversations. This is navigation loss, not evidence of server data loss.
findings.fix: Account-scoped explicit Continue previous task affordance, preserve New task; canonical read before opening, never resume foreign/completed/abandoned blindly.
findings.acceptance: Successful incomplete turn, process restart, same-account Continue restores transcript/facts; New task remains blank; logout/other account reveals none.

findings.title: Inbox promises a conversation before reader includes it
findings.problem: Copy says a conversation appears as soon as Agreement exists; inner lateral joins require at least one visible message.
findings.fix: Explain first-message condition concisely and retain Otvori Dogovore action, or intentionally add empty conversations through separately proven reader change.
findings.acceptance: New Agreement without message shows truthful empty copy and route to correct Agreement; after first message one thread appears.

findings.title: Private unread is unknown; group unread alone is rendered
findings.problem: Returning user cannot distinguish unseen private replies through inbox unread marks. Do not infer unread from last sender or timestamps.
findings.fix: Separate reliable account-scoped private ACK/unread read-model package; only then expose mark/count and matching tab attention.
findings.acceptance: Two accounts/read/reopen/multiple devices; private read ACK and count agree, group visibility remains unchanged.

findings.confidence: OLD_EMULATOR observed; current renderer cause NOTVERIFIED
findings.title: Previous native maps had roads but missing place/street text and cluster numbers
findings.problem: b52 captures show geometry without labels, reducing exact-pin and dense-city comprehension. This is not proof that style or current phone is broken.
findings.fix: Bounded current-APK physical/runtime comparison, isolate native renderer versus glyph/style before production patch.
findings.acceptance: Known viewport contains expected street/place names and numbered clusters; exact point can be selected and recovered with working names.

findings.confidence: SOURCE confirmed markers; desired road-route acceptance open
findings.title: Route preview is ordered stops, not in-app road navigation geometry
findings.problem: Overview iterates numbered markers; no road polyline/duration computed there. Browser route action exists. Do not call this a complete calculated route in product copy.
findings.fix: Name preview as confirmed stops; validate real multi-stop AI flow. If road geometry is required, separate scoped capability with genuine provider result.
findings.acceptance: Start/via/end in correct order survive correction/review/publish/detail; exact versus approximate visibility preserved; external route never silently drops stops.

findings.confidence: SOURCE conditional; actual release contact NOTVERIFIED
findings.title: Restricted-account support disappears without configured public email
findings.problem: A correct no-invented-contact fallback has only exit. For public release, restricted user needs actual reachable public support; private support requires account.
findings.fix: Verify owner-approved release support address and mailto failure path; do not invent a contact or change legal text.
findings.acceptance: Restricted sign-in offers working contact on actual release build and handles missing mail client truthfully.

findings.title: Offline Home wording can mean never mind
findings.problem: Nema veze is ambiguous in Serbian.
findings.fix: Nema internet veze. Prikazano je poslednje učitano. or current accurate connection-neutral wording.
findings.acceptance: Stale state retains last data, exposes retry and does not imply successful freshness.
